title: Hogwarts Legacy
provenance: community consensus (AppleGamingWiki / r-macgaming / MacPlay), unverified by Highball Failure report with a crash dump from WaterWANG-1014 (highball-db#48, 2026-09-15).
notes: DirectX 12, so D3DMetal, and heavy. The game assumes AVX, so the recipe advertises it to the game (confirmed on an M4 Max, highball-db#48, without it the game crashes seconds after launch whatever the mode). On macOS 15.7.7 the game then refused to initialise DirectX 12 on D3DMetal; every DirectX 12 game verified here ran on macOS 26, so that path may need 26. The DirectX 11 path (-dx11) on DXMT is the alternative to try, unverified. DXMT and DXVK cannot run the DirectX 12 build.

knownIssues.symptom: Crashes a few seconds after launch at the same addresses whatever the graphics mode (reported on an M4 Max)
knownIssues.cause: confirmed by the reporter: the game assumes AVX, which Rosetta hides unless asked
knownIssues.fix: the recipe advertises AVX to the game (ROSETTA_ADVERTISE_AVX=1)

knownIssues.symptom: "Failed to initialize DirectX 12. Graphics drivers may require an update" after about 30 seconds on D3DMetal (reported on an M4 Max, macOS 15.7.7)
knownIssues.cause: not measured; no DirectX 12 game has been verified here on macOS 15, all on macOS 26
knownIssues.fix: unverified: the game's DirectX 11 path on DXMT with the -dx11 Steam launch option, or macOS 26
